title: iBrowse haptic device profile
description: Describes a USB HID haptic device: which device it is, and the raw output report to send for each haptic event. Schema version 1.

id.description: A short stable identifier: lower case letters, digits and dashes.

name.description: What a person would call the device. It is spoken aloud.

match.description: Which attached device this is for. Give as much as is needed to tell it apart from other devices.

reportId.description: The HID output report id the reports are sent with.

events.description: The report bytes for each haptic event the device can express. Events left out are skipped, not faked.

intensity.description: If present, this byte of every report is replaced by the intensity setting (0 to 1), scaled to 0 to max. It must lie inside every event's report.

report.description: The bytes of one output report, without the report id.
